independent_oracle: runs/step4.13-review.independent/oracle (own netlist writer, testbench, VCD parser and fanout counter; exact agreement)

pair.penalty_label: accuracy-failed hardware diagnostic, not a selected model

workload: 270 saved validation images in saved order, one per clock at nominal 12 MHz, standalone head-only core (LAT 3); no test data loaded

synthesis_yosys_ice40_up.fit_note: Synthesis counts only; packing/fit not established by the probe

decision_rule: PAUSE iff R < 2% on both M1 and M2 (unrounded)
margin_note: M1 exceeds the threshold by 1.21 percentage points on one seed with zero delay; the final 4.14 decision may still be STOP or INCONCLUSIVE.

analysis_not_validated_measurement.interpretation: The penalty saves mostly in layers 1-2; layer 4, which drives the popcount, changes only 3.6%. Popcount/adder and merged-gate LUT activity is about 60% of mapped M1 and essentially unchanged. Only about 870 of 4,000 learned gates survive as their own nets after technology mapping.
analysis_not_validated_measurement.M2_note: About half of the M2 reduction (20,879 of 41,685) comes from input-register flip-flops whose toggles are identical in both models but drive fewer cell inputs in the penalized model (2,192 vs 2,383 pins). Excluding them, R2 is 2.37%. Decision unchanged because R1 alone exceeds 2%.

limits: Zero-delay mapped standalone core: no routing, glitches, power or energy
One model seed; screening only, not the final 4.14 decision
Fanout-weighted counts are a rough capacitance stand-in
R includes shared logic (input register, popcount, registers, argmax) by the frozen core definition
